info.title: agent 0.1.0-alpha.4 — Git-native consistency manager for AI-agent skills.
info.description: Git extension for Agent Sync. Installing this .NET tool globally puts `git-agent` on PATH so `git agent <command>` behaves exactly like `agent <command>`. See the AgentSync package for the primary `agent` CLI.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose Git repo, PATH, hooks, and config (--json).

commands.name: install-hooks
commands.description: Configure core.hooksPath and make hooks executable.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report Agent Sync state and drift (--json, --fail-on-drift, --ci).
